title: After work
goal: Say what happens after something with -Andan soň.

intro.text: Put `-An` and *-dan* on the verb, then *soň*: *gel-* → *gelenden soň*, after coming. After a vowel `-An` is just *-n*: *okandan soň*; *e* becomes *ä*: *işländen soň*. The last verb gives the tense: *Işden gelenden soň, nahar iýýärin* (after I get home from work, I eat).

vocab.en: to hurry; to be in a hurry
finally, at last; in the end

exercises.question: How do you say **after coming home**?

why.1: *Öýe gelende* is **when (someone) comes home**, at that moment.
why.2: The first verb shows no tense: no *-di*. **After**: *gelenden soň*.
why.3: *-ýAn* is for what is going on. **After** takes `-An`: *gelenden soň*.

exercises.explain: A final *e* becomes *ä* before *-n*: *işländen*, as in *işlände*.

exercises.en: After I get home from work, I eat.

accept: enden

reject.why: *Gelende* is **when I come**. Before *soň* the verb needs the ablative: *gelenden*.

accept: After eating, we had tea.
After eating, we [drank|had some|drank some] tea.
After [we ate|we had eaten|the meal], we [had|drank] (some) tea.
We [had|drank] (some) tea after [eating|we ate|we had eaten|the meal].

reject.answer: Öýe gelenden soň, saňa jaň etdim.
reject.why: *Jaň etdim* is **I called**. **I'll call**: *jaň ederin* or *men … jaň etjek*.

reject.why: *Jaň etjek* has no ending, so say who: *Men öýe gelenden soň, saňa jaň etjek*. Or use *jaň ederin*.

exercises.explain: *Öýe gelenden soň* (after I get home), then the future at the end: *jaň ederin*.

exercises.question: *Kitaby okandan soň, maňa ber.* What should you do first?

why.2: That would be *okaýarkaň*, while you're reading. `-Andan soň` puts one action after the other.

exercises.explain: *okandan soň, maňa ber*: give it to me after you've read it.

exercises.text: Sapak gutar___ soň, men bazara gitjek.
exercises.en: When the lesson is over, I'm going to the bazaar.

accept: andan

exercises.explain: *Sapak gutarandan soň* (after the lesson ends) has its own subject, *sapak*; *men* goes with *gitjek*.

exercises.title: Batyryň güni
exercises.passage:
Düýn Batyr ir turdy. Ýuwunyp, geýinenden soň, çaý içip, howlukyp işe gitdi. Ol işe wagtynda geldi. Günortan nahar iýenden soň, kärdeşleri bilen biraz gürleşdi.

Işini gutarandan soň, Batyr bazara baryp, et we gök önüm aldy. Öýe gelende, ejesi eýýäm palaw taýýarlapdy. Nahar iýenden soň, ol kitap okady. Ahyrynda, gije sagat on birde ýatdy.
exercises.translation: Yesterday Batyr got up early. After washing and getting dressed, he had tea and hurried off to work. He got to work on time. After eating lunch at noon, he talked a little with his colleagues. After finishing his work, Batyr went to the market and bought meat and vegetables. When he got home, his mother had already made palaw. After eating, he read a book. Finally, at eleven at night, he went to bed.

questions.q: What did Batyr do after washing and getting dressed?
options: he had tea and hurried to work
questions.explain: *Ýuwunyp, geýinenden soň, çaý içip, howlukyp işe gitdi.*

questions.q: When did Batyr go to the market?
questions.explain: *Işini gutarandan soň*: after finishing his work.

questions.q: What had his mother done by the time he got home?
options: she was going to the market
questions.explain: *Eýýäm palaw taýýarlapdy*: the pluperfect, done before he came.
